title: My child gets upset by certain noises. Can Occupational Therapy help?
metaTitle: Managing Sound Sensitivities with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network can help manage your child's sound sensitivities and offer coping strategies. Learn more.
html: Yes, Occupational Therapy can help manage sound sensitivities by offering strategies for desensitization and coping. They may also suggest modifications in your child’s environment to reduce exposure to distressing sounds.
